title: Rising borrowing costs signal funding risks for global AI expansion: Report
description: Financial markets are facing elevated credit risks, particularly for firms operating in the artificial intelligence infrastructure sector. A recent Jefferies report highlights stringent borrowing conditions, which have raised alarms for future AI investments. Companies such as Oracle and CoreWeave are seeing increased credit spreads, driving up borrowing costs. While funding for AI initiatives remains steady, potential growth slowdowns may pressure companies.
